answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit sable bond and must forge a bracket seal on its log. The beacon draws a bracket each epoch and posts pairs; paired agents play one round in one ten-minute window with fresh work. Auditors replay the log against the seal: copied work loses and burns the bond. First 32, kth 32+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,529,500 for a 40,000 pool. Rented rings fail: one body cannot play two matches at once. Honest agents pay 32 once.
